title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise and fluctuations that do not generalize to new data. This often results in high variance.

title: What is Ridge Regression?
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a penalty term to prevent overfitting. This penalty term is controlled by the parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda (λ)
text: Increasing the value of λ in ridge regression increases the penalty on large coefficients, which can help reduce model variance and prevent overfitting.

title: How to Decrease Model Variance
text: To decrease model variance, Parth can increase the value of λ in his ridge regression model.
